text: {"name":"bt_link_event_time_adjust","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Adjusts a Bluetooth link event's candidate time against other link timing windows and passes the selected time to the controller handler.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v3":"link_table_base","v4":"controller_context","v5":"associated_link_context","v6":"link_index","v7":"link_record","v14":"candidate_event_time","v30":"peer_link_record"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Controller-context timestamp used as the event timing reference."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Controller-context link index."},{"offset":27,"meaning":"Associated-link byte; 0xff is treated as an absent or invalid value."},{"offset":72,"meaning":"On the input object, pointer to an associated link context; on a link-table record, pointer used to identify its active context."},{"offset":86,"meaning":"Related link index or identifier; 0xff is treated as absent."}]}
